interpretation.supported: The fixed U->D transition-regime correspondence remains exceptional when terminal edges are excluded from the scored statistic. The signal is therefore not confined to terminal tip-state separation under the declared CTMC/Brownian reconstruction.
interpretation.boundary: Internal environmental values are Brownian reconstructions from present-day tip niche centroids. Internal-edge support does not establish observed ancestral environments, historical transition ages, causation, selection or adaptation.

claim_ceiling: Internal-edge support is evidence against a purely terminal-edge explanation, not direct observation of ancestral environments.
Brownian internal environmental values are reconstructed from present-day niche centroids.
No result establishes climatic causation, selection, adaptation, convergence, or a physiological mediator.
